Sellers, 19 floors, forced opening; each row moves the target run toward the other scale and is reported as a share of the A0 log-odds gap between scales of the same floors (G_N = +18.39 nats; under A1 the gap is +3.12 nats, 17% of G_N), 95% bootstrap CI over floors. Patches act on the aligned tokens (the prompt after the limit and the reply's 11 opening tokens) unless marked. "A0 scale difference added" (A1 prompts only) adds the A0 run's other-scale-minus-this-scale states to the A1 run. The eight heads are the discovery phase's scale heads (X57); directions are leave-one-floor-out.
